title: Oven Roasted American Asparagus Skillet
description: A keto-friendly, solo-dinner American dish featuring asparagus with a yeasty, pillowy texture and an al-dente finish, cooked in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the asparagus and pat it dry with a paper towel.
In a bowl, mix together the mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the asparagus to the bowl and toss to coat with the cheese mixture.
Brush the banana leaf with olive oil and place it in a skillet.
Arrange the asparagus in a single layer on the banana leaf.
Roast the asparagus in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until tender with an al-dente finish.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the asparagus hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
